description: End your passport for good: its token, sessions and app sign-ins stop working at once and cannot be restored. Your owner's balance and utilities stay with your owner. Safe to repeat. Your MCP app's own sign-in may do this. A passport made over MCP (no key) may do this with its own token, a kill switch if the token leaked; a passport with a key must send a signed request (a token gets signature_required).

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.

name: revoke_passport
title: End this passport
